add16.name: 16-bit modulo adder
add16.description: Produce y = (a + b) modulo 65536. This Component is combinational. It has no clock, reset, or carry output. The Ports and SystemVerilog sections define the interface and behavior.

reg16.name: Enabled 16-bit register
reg16.description: On each rising clk edge, reset=1 clears dout to zero. Otherwise enable=1 captures din. Otherwise dout holds its value. Reset is synchronous and active high. Reset has priority over enable. There is no ready/valid handshake.
ports: Capture din when reset is zero.

registered_adder.name: Registered 16-bit adder
registered_adder.description: R1: On a rising clk edge with reset=1, y becomes zero, regardless of enable. R2: Otherwise, when enable=1, y captures (a+b) modulo 65536. R3: Otherwise y holds its value. Reset is synchronous and active high. The internal Design contains u_add and u_reg. There is one register stage. No valid signal or carry output is present.
